what_this_is: Human-readable prose for the `clean replacement status` scorecard rows and the Rust-first tooling migration rows. It lives in data/ and NOT in crates/clean-cli/src/cmd_replacement/**/*.rs because that directory is digested into reports/kernel-soundness-launch-evidence.json by sha256_repo_module_tree: correcting one stale word in a sentence used to stale that artifact and flip the kernel-differential row Green -> PendingEvidence, which is why this surface's prose rotted while its logic was maintained. Only fields that NO predicate reads belong here; every decision-bearing field (status, gate_command, evidence_artifact, command, replacement_critical, planned_rust_surface) stays in code and stays digest-pinned.
